free_tier.stated: free zone on any plan with anycast resolution, an API, DNSSEC and 200 records per zone on zones created on or after 2024-09-01
free_tier.notes: 1,000 records per zone on zones created before 2024-09-01

per_object_cap.stated: 200 DNS records per zone on a zone created on or after 2024-09-01; 1,000 on an older free zone; 3,500 on Pro and Business
per_object_cap.notes: records that other Cloudflare services add, such as Email Routing TXT and MX, count toward the same quota

retention.stated: the zone persists while it is active; a zone whose nameservers stop pointing at Cloudflare moves to a Moved state and is deleted after a long enough period

egress.terms: DNS queries are never limited or capped on any plan

interface_detail: a REST API for zones and records; a DoH and DoT resolver at cloudflare-dns.com; flarectl and the Cloudflare Terraform provider
tooling: the Cloudflare API, flarectl, Terraform, certbot with a DNS-01 plugin, acme.sh
chaining: the only free DNS in this set that also gives a free CDN, a free tunnel, free Universal SSL and free Email Routing on the same zone

limits.value: 200 records per zone on a free zone created on or after 2024-09-01
the API is rate limited per account; the published DNS limit is on queries, and there are none

limits_note: the dashboard warns at 85% of the record quota and the current quota and usage are readable per zone through the API

identity_cost.detail: a Cloudflare account, and the domain must use Cloudflare nameservers

confidence_note: the keyless DoH resolver answered a real query, and the record quota and the apex CNAME behaviour are both first-party pages. No zone was created.

evidence.proved: 200, 251 bytes of JSON with Status 0 and two A records, so the keyless DoH endpoint answers programmatically without an account

Per-zone quota: Free zones created before 2024-09-01 00:00:00 UTC 1,000; Free zones created on or after 2024-09-01 200; Pro 3,500; Business 3,500; Enterprise per-account. Records created by other Cloudflare services count toward the quota
'Cloudflare's CNAME flattening allows you to create CNAME records at your zone apex'; an ANAME or ALIAS at a previous provider can be recreated as a CNAME at @
'Cloudflare never limits or caps DNS queries'; a zone in a Moved state for long enough is deleted

notes: 200 records is the number a per-tenant subdomain scheme meets, and it is shared with the records Cloudflare adds for Email Routing. The absence of a query cap is what makes it the default choice.
